The Lallantop Show, Episode no. 2133| 12 November 2026
In today’s LT show, Abhishek is discussing the following news:
The Lallantop Show will discuss the terrorist attack in Kashmir. Terrorists ambushed and shot dead two Special Police Officers (SPOs) in the Kishtwar district. Their bullet-riddled bodies were recovered. The show will explain the entire incident and discuss with experts what is behind the rise in these attacks.
